home.section: Home, me and the shell (Phase 2; the search box)
home.when: the start for the current issuer: the morning note's last text, the reconciliation tile, the short-side tiles with their dates, the open signals by severity, the price with the events overlay, the next thirty days' events, the latest upload per kind with its tie state; a new installation's one button, Add your first issuer

search.section: Home, me and the shell (Phase 2; the search box)
search.when: the one box's results grouped by kind with highlights — a Viewer's results never name a person

notifications.section: Home, me and the shell (Phase 2; the search box)

activity.section: Home, me and the shell (Phase 2; the search box)

settings.section: Home, me and the shell (Phase 2; the search box)
settings.when: my preferences: the morning note and its hour, the minimum signal severity, email and text, which issuers

settings-tokens.section: Home, me and the shell (Phase 2; the search box)
settings-tokens.when: my MCP tokens and my API keys: mint (shown once), rotate, revoke

issuer-list.section: Issuers, securities, share counts and the DTC participants (slice 1)
issuer-list.when: the issuers they may see, as cards: name, ticker, exchange, the primary security's CUSIP, the last position date, the restriction mark

issuer-view.section: Issuers, securities, share counts and the DTC participants (slice 1)
issuer-view.when: one issuer: the EDGAR entity, the securities, the share counts, the transfer agent, the restriction list, the last uploads, the sources' state for it

issuer-add.section: Issuers, securities, share counts and the DTC participants (slice 1)
issuer-add.when: to set up an issuer: the ticker with the CIK lookup, the name, the exchange, the transfer agent and its connector, the time zone

issuer-edit.section: Issuers, securities, share counts and the DTC participants (slice 1)
issuer-edit.when: to change an issuer's fields, holidays, notes

issuer-securities.section: Issuers, securities, share counts and the DTC participants (slice 1)
issuer-securities.when: the issuer's securities with CUSIP, class, ticker, primary; add and edit forms on the page

issuer-share-counts.section: Issuers, securities, share counts and the DTC participants (slice 1)
issuer-share-counts.when: the dated share counts by kind and source; record one

issuer-access.section: Issuers, securities, share counts and the DTC participants (slice 1)
issuer-access.when: the restriction list: the members who may see this issuer; add and remove (managers)

participant-list.section: Issuers, securities, share counts and the DTC participants (slice 1)
participant-list.when: the DTC participants as cards by class with number, name, aliases, the latest position for the current security

participant-view.section: Issuers, securities, share counts and the DTC participants (slice 1)
participant-view.when: one participant: the series chart for the current security, the NOBO summary on each record date, the OBO remainder, aliases, class with its source, notes, tags

participant-edit.section: Issuers, securities, share counts and the DTC participants (slice 1)
participant-edit.when: to set a participant's class (manual) and notes

upload-list.section: Uploads and THE SPR — THE FIRST EXEMPLAR (slice 2)
upload-list.when: the uploads of the current issuer by kind with their tie state, counts, who and when; the queue

upload-add.section: Uploads and THE SPR — THE FIRST EXEMPLAR (slice 2)
upload-add.when: to upload a file: the kind, the security, the connector (detected from the file's first cells where it can be), the record date or period

upload-view.section: Uploads and THE SPR — THE FIRST EXEMPLAR (slice 2)
upload-view.when: one upload: control totals against derived, tied or the difference named, the rows with the ones that failed to type first, the override, the matcher's counts, delete and restore

positions.section: Uploads and THE SPR — THE FIRST EXEMPLAR (slice 2)
positions.when: the position table: the participants ranked on a date for the current security with the class chip, the change against the previous date and the window's open and net

positions-matrix.section: Uploads and THE SPR — THE FIRST EXEMPLAR (slice 2)
positions-matrix.when: the movement matrix: participants by position dates, the cells coloured by change, sortable by net; one column a date at 375

positions-flow.section: Uploads and THE SPR — THE FIRST EXEMPLAR (slice 2)
positions-flow.when: the flow by class: net shares per class per date as a stacked bar and a cumulative line, with the lore caveat printed under it

positions-concentration.section: Uploads and THE SPR — THE FIRST EXEMPLAR (slice 2)
positions-concentration.when: the concentration over time: top-5, top-10, top-20 shares of the DTC total and the index

reconciliation.section: Uploads and THE SPR — THE FIRST EXEMPLAR (slice 2)
reconciliation.when: the reconciliation's runs for the current security: outstanding against the register's components, Cede against the SPR total, tied or the differences named; run one now

holder-list.when: the holders of the current issuer as cards (names for the PII roles; "Individual holder" for a Viewer) with the latest position, the accounts, the kind; filters

holder-view.when: one holder: the accounts (the registration lines as read — PII roles), the positions by record date and channel as a chart, the insider and institution links, notes, tags, Merge into… (managers)

holder-edit.when: to set a holder's kind, entity type, address, notes (PII roles)

holder-merge.when: the two-column compare page for a merge: this holder and the one chosen by the picker; Merge (managers)

holders-unmatched.when: the queue: a raw registration on the left, the candidates with score and evidence on the right; Accept, Reject, New holder, Set kind

holders-changes.when: holders between two record dates: new, lost, up, down with the shares

holders-ranges.when: holders by share range on a record date — from the list, and from Broadridge's Share Range Analysis with the OBO population when one is loaded

holders-geography.when: holders by country and state on a record date

holders-custodians.when: NOBO holders and shares by custodian (participant) and account kind on a record date, beside the OBO remainder

holders-register.when: the register's rows on a record date by position type with Cede flagged, and the components the reconciliation reads

filing-list.section: EDGAR — the index, the text, the watch and the dilution instruments (slice 4)
filing-list.when: the filings of the current issuer: form, date, items, title, the text and structured chips, about-us filings by others

filing-view.section: EDGAR — the index, the text, the watch and the dilution instruments (slice 4)
filing-view.when: one filing: the text with search hits highlighted, the structured block when it is a 13D, a Form 4 or a 144, the event it made; Fetch text, Make event

filings-search.section: EDGAR — the index, the text, the watch and the dilution instruments (slice 4)
filings-search.when: a search in the words of every filing's text with highlights

watch-hits.section: EDGAR — the index, the text, the watch and the dilution instruments (slice 4)
watch-hits.when: the full-text watch's hits with the term, the filing and the snippet; Confirm instrument, Dismiss

dilution-list.section: EDGAR — the index, the text, the watch and the dilution instruments (slice 4)
dilution-list.when: the dilution instruments as cards: kind, counterparty, facility and remaining, the price terms, the floating-price flag, the status

dilution-view.section: EDGAR — the index, the text, the watch and the dilution instruments (slice 4)
dilution-view.when: one instrument with its filing, terms, remaining, notes and the signals it is part of

dilution-add.section: EDGAR — the index, the text, the watch and the dilution instruments (slice 4)
dilution-add.when: to record an instrument by hand

dilution-edit.section: EDGAR — the index, the text, the watch and the dilution instruments (slice 4)
dilution-edit.when: to confirm or change an instrument's kind, counterparty, amounts, terms, status

institution-list.when: the 13F and 13D/13G filers as cards with kind, the latest holding in the current security, the activist mark

institution-view.when: one institution: its holdings in the current security by quarter as a chart, its 13D/13G history, its filings about us, aliases, notes, tags

institution-edit.when: to set an institution's kind, activist flag, website, notes

ownership-13f.when: the 13F table for a quarter: holders ranked with shares, value, voting authority and the share of outstanding; the quarter's summary and the concentration

ownership-13f-changes.when: the quarter against the prior: new, out, up, down, with the shares

ownership-beneficial.when: the 5% holders: the latest 13D or 13G per filer with percent, shares, the event date and the purpose

ownership-insiders.when: the insider ledger: Form 3/4/5 transactions by person with codes, shares, price, owned after, and the register link

ownership-144.when: the Form 144 notices: seller, shares, approximate date, broker

short.when: the short-side page: one chart of price and volume above and short interest as a share of float, fails, the 5-day short-volume ratio, threshold days shaded and borrow points below, with the events overlay

short-interest.when: the short-interest series as a table: settlement date, publication, short, change, days to cover, the share of float and of outstanding, revisions

short-volume.when: FINRA's daily off-exchange short volume with the 5- and 20-day means and the caveat on the page

short-fails.when: the fails-to-deliver series with the share of outstanding and the 60-day median

short-threshold.when: the threshold-list history: on which list, since when, the runs

short-borrow.when: the borrow observations: date, source, fee, utilisation, note

borrow-add.when: to record a borrow observation: the date, the source (broker quote or manual), the fee, the utilisation, shares on loan and available, a note

signal-list.when: the signals of the current issuer as cards by severity with the evidence-class chip, the rule, the window, the summary, the agent's proposal when one waits

signal-view.when: one signal: the summary, the basis paragraph, the evidence rendered as rows and a chart of the window, the related events, the outcome prices; Acknowledge, Dismiss with a reason and the explaining event, Escalate; the Analyst's proposal with Take it

signal-history.when: every signal of a period with its disposition, who and why; the proposals accepted and rejected

rule-list.when: the rules catalogue: key, name, class, basis, severity, thresholds, last fired, enabled; the per-issuer overrides

rule-edit.when: to set a rule's thresholds and enable it, globally or for the current issuer (managers)

event-list.section: Events, the calendar, reports and the pack (slice 8)
event-list.when: the timeline of the current issuer: filings, financings, record dates, earnings, short reports, notes — by kind and severity

event-view.section: Events, the calendar, reports and the pack (slice 8)
event-view.when: one event with its filing, the signals it explains, notes, tags

event-add.section: Events, the calendar, reports and the pack (slice 8)
event-add.when: to record an event: the date, the kind, the title, the body, the URL, the severity

event-edit.section: Events, the calendar, reports and the pack (slice 8)

calendar.section: Events, the calendar, reports and the pack (slice 8)
calendar.when: the month grid of what happened and what is coming: record dates, earnings, expiries, publication days

report-list.section: Events, the calendar, reports and the pack (slice 8)
report-list.when: the packs as cards: kind, period, status, approved by; the Friday draft

report-view.section: Events, the calendar, reports and the pack (slice 8)
report-view.when: one pack: the narrative (the agent's draft or the person's edit), the sections toggled, the rendered preview, Approve, Download PDF, Send to… (members)

report-add.section: Events, the calendar, reports and the pack (slice 8)
report-add.when: to draft a pack by hand: the kind, the period, the sections

report-edit.section: Events, the calendar, reports and the pack (slice 8)
report-edit.when: to edit a draft's narrative and sections (frozen once approved)

export-list.section: Events, the calendar, reports and the pack (slice 8)
export-list.when: my exports and the shared ones: kind, rows, size, expiry; download

proposals.section: Agents, proposals, notifications, K7 and the API (slice 9)
proposals.when: everything the agents proposed and nobody has taken: signal dispositions, holder matches, holder kinds, watch hits — each with its one-click button

admin-agents.section: Agents, proposals, notifications, K7 and the API (slice 9)
admin-agents.when: the agents with their last dispatch, the dispatches table with status and Cancel, the Analyst's settings (issuers, the hour, the pack's day, proposals on or off)

admin-sources.section: Admin: sources, credentials, classes, templates, settings, tokens, purge (slice 10)
admin-sources.when: the fetchers with their schedule, the last pull, the back-off, paused; Pull now, Pause, Resume

admin-source-view.section: Admin: sources, credentials, classes, templates, settings, tokens, purge (slice 10)
admin-source-view.when: one source: its settings, its credential (the label and last4 only), its pulls as a table with status, counts, bytes and the policy followed

admin-source-edit.section: Admin: sources, credentials, classes, templates, settings, tokens, purge (slice 10)
admin-source-edit.when: to change a source's name, base URL, settings, schedule, rate, user-agent override, active

admin-source-credential.section: Admin: sources, credentials, classes, templates, settings, tokens, purge (slice 10)
admin-source-credential.when: to set or rotate the source's credential (never shown back)

admin-participant-classes.section: Admin: sources, credentials, classes, templates, settings, tokens, purge (slice 10)
admin-participant-classes.when: the class vocabulary and which participants sit in each; reclass

admin-templates.section: Admin: sources, credentials, classes, templates, settings, tokens, purge (slice 10)
admin-templates.when: the import templates (the saved column mappings) by kind and connector

admin-template-edit.section: Admin: sources, credentials, classes, templates, settings, tokens, purge (slice 10)

admin-settings.section: Admin: sources, credentials, classes, templates, settings, tokens, purge (slice 10)
admin-settings.when: the application settings: the business name and the EDGAR contact (the user-agent), the exchange, the market time zone and holidays, the EDGAR rate, the reconciliation tolerance, the auto-match threshold, PII in exports, the escalation member, the key rates, the upload ceiling, the price source

admin-tokens.section: Admin: sources, credentials, classes, templates, settings, tokens, purge (slice 10)
admin-tokens.when: everyone's keys and tokens: label, person, scope, limits, usage; revoke

admin-purge.section: Admin: sources, credentials, classes, templates, settings, tokens, purge (slice 10)
admin-purge.when: the tombstones waiting: uploads, holders, events, reports, issuers; restore or purge now
